name: BrightLocal
description_en:
BrightLocal combines local rank and map-grid monitoring, citation checks, listing synchronization and reputation workflows. The current Track, Manage and Grow plans build on each other, while Citation Builder, managed services and API solutions have separate commercial arrangements. Local AI Visibility adds a small configured question panel rather than a census of every AI answer.

A practical evaluation follows one business Location: confirm its public identity, choose a search area and keywords, inspect a report, then review any listing change or review request before sending. New and legacy platform guides coexist, so use the version matching the account. This profile is based on public official documents; no listing was changed, contact imported, message sent or report run.
description_zh:
BrightLocal 集成本地排名及地图网格监控、商家引用检查、资料同步及评价流程。当前 Track、Manage、Grow 逐档扩展，Citation Builder、托管服务及 API 方案另有商业安排。Local AI Visibility 增加小型配置问题面板，不是全部 AI 回答的普查。

适合评估的流程围绕一个商家 Location：核公开身份，选搜索区域及关键词，检查报告，再审任何资料修改或评价请求后发送。新旧平台指南并存，需匹配账户版本。本条依据官方公开文档，未改商家资料、导联系人、发送消息或运行报告。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure the actual search town/postcode, engines and business identity separately.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分别配置真实搜索城镇／邮编、引擎及商家身份。

core_features.explanation_en: Compare a keyword across points and completed report dates.
core_features.explanation_zh: 比较关键词在各点及已运行日期的排名。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect a publisher and explicitly enable Active Sync for an active Location.
core_features.explanation_zh: 连接发布平台，并对活动 Location 明确启用 Active Sync。

core_features.explanation_en: A paid campaign includes checking, submission and later live-listing review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费活动包含核查、提交及后续上线目录检查。

core_features.explanation_en: Templates feed email, SMS, link and kiosk workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 模板用于邮件、短信、链接及现场终端流程。

en: Measure a fixed local keyword/grid panel for one business area.
Correct selected listing details and verify publication on native sites.
Review a customer-feedback campaign and separate private feedback from public reviews.
zh: 测一个商圈的固定本地词／网格面板。
修所选商家资料并在原站验证发布。
审客户反馈活动，区分私下反馈及公开评价。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Confirm the Location identity, Maps URL and actual search area.
steps.zh: 核 Location 身份、Maps URL 及真实搜索区域。

steps.en: Align Grid section dates and keywords before comparing.
steps.zh: 比较前对齐 Grid 各部分日期及关键词。

steps.en: Review a small branded/unbranded AI panel and schedule.
steps.zh: 审小型品牌／非品牌 AI 面板及计划。

steps.en: Inspect native listings and staged sync actions before saving.
steps.zh: 保存前审原生资料及待定同步动作。

steps.en: Preview both feedback paths before importing recipients or sending.
steps.zh: 导收件人或发送前预览两种反馈路径。

items.en: Local AI Visibility export and white-label reporting are not yet available.
items.zh: Local AI Visibility 暂无导出及白标报告。

items.en: Read-only users see all account locations and reports.
items.zh: 只读用户可见全账户 Location 及报告。

items.en: Stopping Active Sync does not revert prior published changes.
items.zh: 停 Active Sync 不撤销此前发布修改。

items.en: Citation submission completion is different from directory publication.
items.zh: 商家引用提交完成不同于目录发布。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The explicit one-Location USD table lists monthly Track $41, Manage $54, Grow $65; annual totals $369/$485/$584, shown as rounded $31/$40/$49 monthly equivalents. Higher location bands differ; do not multiply the one-location amount. Fourteen-day no-card trial; afterward existing data can be viewed but no new/refreshed reports without a plan. Citation Builder is separate, $3.20/site or $2 with bulk credits; no platform plan required. Managed service $1,299/month; API custom quote. Tax and account-specific totals not verified. Non-refundable unused time, subject to documented case-specific exceptions. No normalized price.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 明确的一 Location USD 表列月付 Track $41、Manage $54、Grow $65，年总额 $369／$485／$584，显示约每月 $31／$40／$49。更高门店档不同，不能单门店价直接相乘。十四天免卡试用，之后可看已有数据，但无套餐不能新建／刷新报告。Citation Builder 独立，每站 $3.20 或批量积分 $2，无需平台套餐。托管每月 $1,299，API 询价。税及账户总额未核，未用期不退款，文档列个案例外，不设标准化价。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Search location differs from the business identifier
sections.title_zh: 搜索位置不同于商家识别字段
sections.en: Local Rank Tracker separates its search town/postcode from the postcode used to identify name matches on third-party sites. Choose engines, up to one hundred keywords, business URL and optional competitor settings. Main-domain tracking finds subpages, while a specified subpage does not include pages beneath it under the guide’s rule. Reports can run ad hoc, weekly or monthly with a timezone; Add Report saves and starts the first run. Editorial baseline: check the Maps URL and actual search location before comparing reports. A correct business postcode in Name Tracking alone does not establish the intended search origin.
sections.zh: Local Rank Tracker 区分搜索城镇／邮编及第三方站姓名匹配识别用邮编。选引擎、最多一百词、商家 URL 及可选竞品。指南规则中主域可找到子页，指定子页不涵盖其下页面。报告可按需、周或月运行并设时区，Add Report 保存并启动首轮。编辑基线：比较前核 Maps URL 及真实搜索位置，仅 Name Tracking 商家邮编正确不确定搜索起点正确。

sections.title_en: Each Grid section keeps its own keyword and date
sections.title_zh: Grid 各部分独立保留关键词及日期
sections.en: The new Local Search Grid has an overview, date comparison, competitor table and direct comparison. Changing one section’s keyword/date does not update the others. A point can show ranks one through one hundred; a dash means outside the top hundred, while red includes positions over twenty. Clicking a point exposes the ranked businesses at that location. Editorial local comparison: align every section to the same keyword, dates and grid configuration before describing gains. A single average can hide neighborhood variation, and a dash is not evidence that a business never appears anywhere in Google.
sections.zh: 新 Local Search Grid 有概览、日期比较、竞品表及直接比较；一部分改词／日期不更新其他部分。点可显示一至一百名，横线表示前百外，红色含二十名后；点击点可看该地排名商家。编辑本地比较：描述进展前让各部分的词、日期及网格配置一致。单平均可掩盖街区差异，横线不证明商家在整个 Google 从未出现。

sections.title_en: AI visibility is a configured twenty-question panel
sections.title_zh: AI 可见性是配置的二十问题面板
sections.en: Local AI Visibility requires an active Location and supports up to twenty branded/unbranded prompts across ChatGPT, Google AI Overview and AI Mode. The composite Visibility score combines frequency, placement, sentiment and recommendation strength; Mention rate, share of business mentions and average position are different measures. Weekly/monthly scheduling and on-demand runs are separate choices; a manual rerun spends a manual report run. Editorial setup: mix relevant discovery questions with explicit brand checks, retain the exact panel and inspect platform-level results. Suggested questions are AI-generated candidates, not measured customer search volumes, and the published composite description does not establish a reproducible weighting formula.
sections.zh: Local AI Visibility 需活动 Location，最多二十个品牌／非品牌词，覆盖 ChatGPT、Google AI Overview 及 AI Mode。综合 Visibility score 合频率、位置、情感及推荐强度，Mention rate、商家提及份额及平均位置各异。周／月计划与按需独立，手动重跑耗一次手动报告。编辑设置：结合相关发现问题及明确品牌检查，保留准确面板并审平台细分。建议问题是 AI 候选，不是实测客户搜索量；公开综合描述不能确定可复现权重公式。

sections.title_en: Connected publishers do not automatically synchronize
sections.title_zh: 连接发布平台不自动同步
sections.en: Active Sync requires the relevant entitlement and an active Location. A profile can be connected while an inactive Location cannot sync. Enable the separate Active Sync switch and complete required fields before Save and Sync. Business details can share descriptions or use publisher-specific text; images require their own enabled publishing setting. Deleting an image from BrightLocal does not remove it from the destination platform. Editorial listing change: inspect the authoritative business data, publisher tabs and native listing afterward. A connection indicator alone is not evidence that opening hours, categories or images have been published.
sections.zh: Active Sync 需相应权益及活动 Location，非活动 Location 可连接资料却不能同步。需另开 Active Sync、补必填再 Save and Sync。描述可共用或逐发布平台独立，图片发布另有启用设置。从 BrightLocal 删图片不从目标平台删除。编辑资料变更：审权威商家数据、各发布标签，并读回原生资料。连接指示本身不证明营业时间、类别或图片已发布。

sections.title_en: Alert decisions need saving; stopping sync does not roll back
sections.title_zh: 提醒决策需保存，停同步不回滚
sections.en: Active Sync alerts show current BrightLocal data and a detected external change. Accept/Reject can be staged individually or in bulk, but Save and Sync commits the selected actions; Cancel Updates abandons pending decisions. Initial synchronization includes a consistency check against the business website, and a rejected first sync requires correcting those details. The guide says that validation is not repeated after the initial sync. Stopping Active Sync leaves existing changes in place. Editorial recovery: inspect the actual listing and known business facts before accepting a bulk change; pausing a service is not an undo operation for previously published data.
sections.zh: Active Sync 提醒显示 BrightLocal 当前数据及外部变更。可逐项或批量暂选 Accept／Reject，Save and Sync 才提交，Cancel Updates 放弃待定。首次同步对照商家网站核一致性，被拒需修资料，指南称首次后不重复该验证。停止 Active Sync 保留已有修改。编辑恢复：批量接受前查真实资料及已知商家事实，暂停服务不是撤销已发布数据。

sections.title_en: New Citation Builder setup separates selection, payment and final details
sections.title_zh: 新 Citation Builder 区分选择、付款及最终资料
sections.en: The new guide applies to the Simply Listings cohort and directs pre-August-19-2026 users to the older workflow. A scan separates correct, incorrect and missing listings; the chosen bundle covers fixes and new builds. Address visibility and verification/follow-up preferences affect eligible directories. Payment redirects to the legacy checkout, followed by confirmation of business details. Aggregator selections are country-dependent and the guide describes twelve-month access without automatic renewal. Editorial order review: confirm public address handling, selected sites, required business data and full basket before payment. A saved setup is not a completed submission, and a one-time aggregator purchase is not perpetual synchronization.
sections.zh: 新指南适用 Simply Listings 群体，二〇二六年八月十九日前用户转旧流程。扫描区分正确、错误及缺少目录，所选包同时含修复及新建。地址公开及验证／后续操作偏好影响可选目录。付款转旧结账，之后确认商家资料。聚合器按国家不同，指南列十二个月访问且不自动续费。编辑订单检查：付款前核公开地址处理、站点、所需资料及完整购物篮。已保存设置不等于完成提交，一次性聚合器购买不是永久同步。

sections.title_en: Submission speed is not a guaranteed publication date
sections.title_zh: 提交速度不是保证上线日期
sections.en: The delivery guide separates preliminary consistency checks, submissions, QA and live-listing review. Important missing data or discrepancies can hold the campaign before submission. A selected directory can be replaced if unavailable, unsuitable, rejected or controlled elsewhere. The new setup offers standard submission within seven days or paid express submission within twenty-four hours; the delivery overview describes a campaign commonly lasting six to seven weeks. Editorial acceptance: inspect actual live URLs and replacement sites rather than marking a campaign successful because payment or submission completed. Directory vetting and customer verification can take longer, and no ranking or AI recommendation improvement was established here.
sections.zh: 交付指南区分预检、提交、质检及上线目录检查。关键缺资料或不一致可在提交前暂停；目录不可用、不适配、拒绝或他人控制时可替换。新设置列标准七天内提交、付费加急二十四小时内提交，交付概览列活动通常六至七周。编辑验收：检查真实上线 URL 及替换站，不能仅凭付款或提交完成算成功。目录审核及客户验证可更久，本研究未确定排名或 AI 推荐改善。

sections.title_en: A template, a contact upload and a sent request are different stages
sections.title_zh: 模板、导联系人及发送请求是不同阶段
sections.en: Review Generation can request public reviews directly or first collect internal feedback. Select up to three review sites and the correct Location profiles, then choose email/SMS or link/kiosk delivery. The campaign guide limits a CSV upload to one hundred contacts and requires confirmation of contact rights. Multi-country SMS uses separate files; carrier-dependent credits and enabled follow-ups need their own budget. Follow-ups target people who did not engage with the first message. Editorial campaign check: inspect the template, recipients, destination links and send state separately. Creating or duplicating a reusable template does not send a campaign or establish permission for a new contact list.
sections.zh: Review Generation 可直接请求公开评价或先收内部反馈。选最多三个评价站及准确 Location 资料，再选邮件／短信或链接／终端。活动指南限每 CSV 一百联系人，需确认联系权；跨国短信分文件，运营商相关积分及启用跟进需另预算，跟进面向未参与首消息者。编辑活动检查：分别审模板、收件人、目标链接及发送状态。创建／复制可复用模板不发送活动，也不确定新名单的联系权限。

sections.title_en: Positive and negative feedback both retain a public-review step
sections.title_zh: 正负内部反馈都保留公开评价步骤
sections.en: The internal-feedback template lets the business choose its score threshold and customize separate positive and negative pages. Its documented negative path still asks for a public review, and kiosk/link follow-up emails also exist for both outcomes. Consent to reuse internal feedback in a Showcase Widget is distinct from leaving the feedback. SMS reminders are described at seventy-two hours and deduct credits when sent. Editorial preview: walk both feedback paths and check the public-review links, consent text and enabled reminders. Do not infer that a negative score suppresses public review requests, or describe internal feedback as an automatically published third-party review.
sections.zh: 内部反馈模板可选分数阈值，分别编辑正负页面。文档负路径仍请求公开评价，终端／链接后续邮件也对两种结果存在。内部反馈可用于 Showcase Widget 的同意独立于提交反馈。短信提醒列七十二小时，发送时扣积分。编辑预览：走正负路径，核公开评价链接、同意文字及启用提醒。不能推负分阻止公开评价，也不能将内部反馈说成自动发布的第三方评价。

sections.title_en: Read-only account users still see every Location
sections.title_zh: 只读账户用户仍可见全部 Location
sections.en: The users guide allows unlimited users. Standard users manage all account Locations/reports but cannot manage billing, subscription or users; read-only users also see all Locations/reports. Account Owners/Admins control account management. Local Rank Tracker offers an anonymous external report URL and PDF/CSV, which is different from creating an account-wide user. Local AI Visibility explicitly has no export or white-label reporting yet. Editorial client handoff: choose the documented delivery surface and inspect its contents rather than giving a read-only account merely to show one client. General white-label marketing does not establish AI-report export availability.
sections.zh: 用户指南允许不限用户。Standard 可管全部账户 Location／报告，但不能管账单、订阅或用户；只读同样可见全部 Location／报告，Owner／Admin 管账户。Local Rank Tracker 可用匿名外部报告 URL 及 PDF／CSV，与创建账户级用户不同。Local AI Visibility 明确暂不支持导出或白标报告。编辑客户交付：选择文档支持的交付方式并审内容，不能为展示单客户就授只读全账户。通用白标营销不确定 AI 报告可导出。

sections.title_en: Anywhere retrieves existing account data with read-only access
sections.title_zh: Anywhere 以只读访问提取已有账户数据
sections.en: BrightLocal Anywhere uses an API-key connection to let compatible AI clients retrieve existing report data. The detailed getting-started guide requires an active Grow plan, even though the pricing comparison has a generic MCP row without readable eligibility marks. Its security article describes read-only access and recommends checking AI interpretations against actual data. Editorial assistant use: specify Location, report and date, retain source results and verify unexpected calculations before passing them to a client. No key was created or connector authorized here; a conversational answer does not refresh a stale underlying report or establish that an account change occurred.
sections.zh: BrightLocal Anywhere 用 API key 连接，让兼容 AI 客户端提取已有报告。详细入门需活动 Grow，虽然价格比较有通用 MCP 行但无可读资格标记。安全文档描述只读，并建议对真实数据核 AI 解读。编辑代理使用：明确 Location、报告及日期，保留源结果，交客户前核异常计算。本研究未建 key 或授权连接，聊天回答不刷新过旧底层报告，也不确定账户发生修改。

sections.title_en: Downgrade, cancellation and service ownership have different effects
sections.title_zh: 降档、取消及服务所有权有不同效果
sections.en: The current pricing FAQ says a downgrade takes effect immediately and does not refund unused paid time. Cancellation help instead preserves access through the current paid term, then removes report access while retaining data for possible reactivation. Cancel add-ons before the main subscription; Account Owners/Admins handle billing. Citation Builder remains available per campaign without a platform subscription. The refund guide allows case-specific billing-error/service-failure exceptions, not an unused-time entitlement. Editorial exit: export needed records, check each subscription and effective date, and distinguish losing reporting access from erasing previously published directory listings or undoing Active Sync changes.
sections.zh: 当前价格 FAQ 说降档立即生效、未用已付期不退；取消帮助则保留当前已付期访问，之后失去报告访问但留数据待恢复。先取消附加订阅再主订阅，Owner／Admin 管账单。Citation Builder 无平台订阅仍可逐活动购买。退款指南允许账单错误／服务故障个案例外，不是未用期退款权益。编辑退出：导所需记录、核各订阅及生效日，区分失报告访问与清除已发布目录或撤销 Active Sync 修改。

seo.title_en: BrightLocal: local rank scope, listing sync and review workflows
seo.title_zh: BrightLocal：本地排名范围、资料同步及评价流程
seo.description_en: Evaluate BrightLocal Grid comparisons, AI prompt panels, citation delivery, Active Sync states and client-report access.
seo.description_zh: 核 BrightLocal Grid 比较、AI 提示词面板、目录交付、Active Sync 状态及客户报告访问。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate BrightLocal local SEO reporting and listing/review operations
